items.title_en: Flipkart Delivery Agent 'Exposed His Private Parts' After Entering Bengaluru Woman's House; Internet Reacts
items.title_zh: Flipkart 送货员进入班加罗尔女子家后“暴露私处”；互联网反应
items.summary_en: A Bengaluru woman alleged that a delivery agent forced his way into her flat after she denied him entry, exposed himself after using her washroom, and left her traumatised
items.summary_zh: 一名班加罗尔妇女声称，在她拒绝送货员进入她的公寓后，一名送货员强行进入她的公寓，并在使用洗手间后暴露自己，使她受到精神创伤

items.title_en: Louis Vuitton Diaper Goes Viral After Huggies Face-Off, Internet Says 'Now He Can Poop Gold'
items.title_zh: 路易威登尿布在好奇对峙后走红，互联网称“现在他可以拉黄金了”
items.summary_en: A viral Instagram reel comparing a LV diaper with a Huggies diaper has sparked debate online, with social media users joking about luxury, parenting and extravagant spending
items.summary_zh: Instagram 上一条比较 LV 尿布和 Huggies 尿布的视频在网上疯传，在网上引发了争论，社交媒体用户拿奢侈品、育儿和奢侈消费开玩笑
